name: Sentiment Clarity Lens
summary: Evaluate whether the article expresses clear, interpretable sentiment toward topics or actors.
instructions: Read the article and answer each rubric question using specific evidence from the text. Be concise and cite direct passages when possible.
system_prompt: You are an editorial evaluator. Score content using the rubric with neutral, evidence-based judgments.
user_prompt: Evaluate this article using the sentiment clarity lens rubric.

questions.question: Is the overall tone consistent throughout the article?
Does the article avoid abrupt emotional shifts unrelated to topic transitions?
Is sentiment directed toward identifiable entities (people, policies, institutions)?
Is it clear what or who the emotional tone applies to?
